description: Persistent issue database for the Universal Design Loop. Issues must persist across iterations so the agent can track, prioritize, resolve, regress, and avoid duplicating previously identified problems.

priority_definitions.P0: Critical: blocks the application, core functionality, or major user journey.
priority_definitions.P1: Major: significantly harms visual quality, UX, responsiveness, functionality, or product usability.
priority_definitions.P2: Moderate: meaningful quality issue that should be addressed but does not critically affect the product.
priority_definitions.P3: Polish: minor visual, UX, performance, consistency, or refinement issue.

status_definitions.open: Issue has been identified but work has not started.
status_definitions.in_progress: The current iteration is actively addressing the issue.
status_definitions.resolved: The issue has been fixed and verified.
status_definitions.blocked: The issue cannot currently be resolved because of a dependency, missing information, tooling limitation, or external constraint.
status_definitions.wont_fix: The issue was intentionally not fixed because the cost, risk, or scope is not justified.
status_definitions.duplicate: The issue duplicates an existing issue and should reference the original issue.

category_definitions.visual: Typography, spacing, composition, color, hierarchy, imagery, components, visual consistency, or aesthetics.
category_definitions.ux: Usability, information architecture, interaction clarity, navigation, feedback, forms, or user flow.
category_definitions.responsive: Viewport-specific layout, mobile, tablet, desktop behavior, overflow, scaling, or adaptive composition.
category_definitions.technical: Build, code quality, architecture, runtime errors, console errors, network failures, dependencies, or implementation defects.
category_definitions.accessibility: Keyboard access, screen-reader support, semantic structure, focus, contrast, labels, touch targets, or assistive technology issues.
category_definitions.performance: Loading performance, bundle size, images, rendering cost, layout shifts, network cost, or runtime performance.
category_definitions.functional: A required feature, interaction, workflow, calculation, API action, or business behavior does not work as required.
category_definitions.content: Missing, incorrect, unclear, inconsistent, or inappropriate product content.
category_definitions.security: Authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets, data exposure, injection, or other security concerns.
category_definitions.seo: Metadata, semantic structure, indexing, crawlability, structured data, canonicalization, or SEO-related concerns.
